name: trapezoid
complete_raw_region: def trapezoid (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ := (b-a)*(f a+f b)/2

name: lowerCurvature
complete_raw_region: def lowerCurvature (s : ℝ) : ℝ := (Lcurvature s - 2*lowerSlope s)/s

name: upperTailCurvature
complete_raw_region: def upperTailCurvature (s : ℝ) : ℝ := (Hcurvature s - 2*upperSlope s)/s
